green.purpose: Expressway direction board: gantry and exit boards, Download and Nearby signs, Download open plate.

blue.purpose: Local roads and information: facts sign, info board, Kopitiam, Night market and Kampung exits.

brown.purpose: Tourist attraction sign under every object and the model nameplate.

orange.purpose: Temporary works: View only sign, Review copy plate, stone-jump miss.

red.purpose: Ring of the height and width roundels only.

yellow.purpose: Edge line, lit lamp, route shield, stone band, focus ring, selection, billboard Play.

sheet.purpose: Retroreflective lettering, sign border lines, stones.

asphalt-deep.purpose: Footer, gantry rails, lamp housings, billboard frame.

ink.purpose: Text on yellow, orange, white and concrete; kerb black.

display.purpose: The exit name on each full-bleed exit board.

headline.purpose: Object name on the model page; info board title and billboard head at this level.

stone-number.purpose: Catalogue numbers on kilometre stones, tabular.

shadows.purpose: White border line on every sign face; not depth.

shadows.name: object-on-verge

motion.name: gantry-light
motion.purpose: Board face, lamp and lamplight when the current exit changes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: transition-duration: 0s; instant gantry scroll; --drive frozen; auto-rotate removed

narrative.overview:
The library is a drive through Malaysia. Each exit in site.json is a place off one road; the home page is that road, read top to bottom: a steel gantry overhead, an exit board painted edge to edge, a pale concrete verge where the objects stand, kerb stones, then asphalt with lane paint until the next exit. Every object stands under its own brown attraction sign with a white kilometre stone carrying its catalogue number. Model pages are a single stop on the verge, with the facts on roadside signs below.

Everything is drawn from Malaysian road furniture and nothing else: retroreflective white lettering on sheeting colours, SVG sign arrows and pictograms, posts and unipoles in brushed steel gradients, red-ringed limit roundels. The world refuses the asset-store grid of equal thumbnail cards and the cream museum catalogue. Objects are laid out at mixed widths on the verge, never as a card grid.
keyCharacteristics: Sign colours own whole regions: an exit board is its colour edge to edge.
One road-sign grotesque (Overpass, self-hosted variable font) for every word.
Status is carried by sign form and words, not by hue alone.
Measurements are signs: height and width roundels pinned to the viewer.
The gantry lights the exit you are in; the others stay matte.

rules.name: The Sheeting Rule
rules.body: A sign face is one sheeting colour with a white border line inset from its edge. Lettering on green, blue and brown is white; lettering on orange and yellow is ink.

rules.name: The Unlit Board Rule
rules.body: Gantry boards that are not current are their board colour mixed 38% toward deep asphalt (color-mix(in oklab, var(--board), var(--asphalt-deep) 38%)). Only the current board shows the full colour, the yellow lamp and the lamplight gradient.

rules.name: The Tabular Stone Rule
rules.body: Every catalogue number, size and file figure uses tabular numerals (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

rules.name: The Local Name Rule
rules.body: A local name always sits directly under the English name, lighter (500) and smaller, never replacing it.

rules.name: The Furniture Depth Rule
rules.body: Signs never cast shadows of their own; they stand on posts drawn with a steel gradient (linear-gradient(90deg, dark, light 45%, dark)). Lift belongs to objects, the gantry, roundels and billboards.

dos: Do show status by sign form: a cleared download is a full green Download board (and a green "Download open" plate on the verge); anything not cleared is an orange works sign or plate, with words saying so.
Do give every object its brown attraction sign and its kilometre stone; keying the stone number in the gantry must reach it.
Do paint each exit board edge to edge in its board colour: green on the expressway, blue for local roads.
Do show measurements as roundels on the viewer, never as a caption.

Do honour reduced motion: under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce every transition is 0s, the gantry swaps boards instantly instead of smooth-scrolling, --drive stops updating so the lane paint holds still, and auto-rotate is removed from the live model.
Do keep KL Rush on the billboards only: KL Rush and nothing else, on a billboard whose visible plate says "Advertisement", with images and scripts served from this site.
donts: Don't advertise anything other than KL Rush, mention KL Rush outside the billboards, or add ad networks, analytics or any third-party script; the viewer, its decoders and the font are vendored and self-hosted.
Don't lay objects out as a grid of equal thumbnail cards.
Don't add a second typeface or use a system display face.
Don't draw icons with font glyphs or emoji; arrows and pictograms are SVG on the 24-unit grid.
Don't use orange, red or brown for anything outside their sign meanings (works, limits, attractions).
